channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Wednesday's three conversions are about who controls the power. CoreWeave entered India as sole tenant of a 240 MW AdaniConneX campus at Taloja, Navi Mumbai, with Vera Rubin planned and first capacity in mid-2028. Black Hills signed definitive agreements, effective 30 Sep and running through 2048, to serve Google's planned Cheyenne, Wyoming data center with a 2.7 GW resource mix, including $1.8 billion of new gas generation and a 2.1 GW private microgrid, ramping from late 2027 to peak in 2030. TeraWulf doubled contracted power at its Muskie campus in Kentucky to 1 GW and pulled the second 500 MW into 2029, subject to the Kentucky PSC. The public rental tape is a full confirm session: 69 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW. AWS's Capacity Blocks banner says new rates take effect 7 Oct (P5 $5.970, P6-B300 $16.146), but the live table at publish still prints P5 $5.191 and P6-B300 $14.04, so no tick is recorded. Brookwood's council backed the TCEDA agreement on 6 Oct; the Alabama PSC power vote is next. Applied Digital reports FQ1 after the close today.

item.title: Compute brief - 7 October 2026
item.description: Wednesday's three conversions are about who controls the power. CoreWeave entered India as sole tenant of a 240 MW AdaniConneX campus at Taloja, Navi Mumbai, with Vera Rubin planned and first capacity in mid-2028. Black Hills signed definitive agreements, effective 30 Sep and running through 2048, to serve Google's planned Cheyenne, Wyoming data center with a 2.7 GW resource mix, including $1.8 billion of new gas generation and a 2.1 GW private microgrid, ramping from late 2027 to peak in 2030. TeraWulf doubled contracted power at its Muskie campus in Kentucky to 1 GW and pulled the second 500 MW into 2029, subject to the Kentucky PSC. The public rental tape is a full confirm session: 69 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW. AWS's Capacity Blocks banner says new rates take effect 7 Oct (P5 $5.970, P6-B300 $16.146), but the live table at publish still prints P5 $5.191 and P6-B300 $14.04, so no tick is recorded. Brookwood's council backed the TCEDA agreement on 6 Oct; the Alabama PSC power vote is next. Applied Digital reports FQ1 after the close today. Countries: India: CoreWeave sole tenant of 3 x 80 MW at AdaniConneX Taloja, Navi Mumbai; option for 240 MW more; Vera Rubin; first phase mid-2028 (Wire, 7 Oct). United States / Wyoming: Black Hills definitive agreements through 2048 for Google's planned Cheyenne campus: 2.7 GW resource mix, 564 MW new gas, 2.1 GW microgrid, service late 2027, peak 2030 (Wire, 6 Oct). United States / Kentucky: TeraWulf Muskie contracted power 500 MW to 1 GW; second phase 2029, subject to Kentucky PSC; no tenant named (Wire, 5 Oct). United States / Alabama: Brookwood council backed the TCEDA agreement for Delta Forge 2 on 6 Oct; Alabama PSC vote on the Alabama Power agreement expected within weeks (Signal). Sweden: Alpha Compute says it signed a binding $71.9M contract for its ALPHA-02 B300 cluster in a hydropowered Swedish data center; customer unnamed; single-source (Signal).
